title: Today's Cerberus
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: As a boy, Chiaki Mikado was bitten by a three-headed puppy and lost a piece of his soul, leaving him unable to enjoy anything. As a teenager he receives a box from his traveling father containing Cerberus, the guardian of the underworld's gates in the form of a girl with three distinct personalities, who moves in to protect him and help him feel joy again (Yen Press blurb via AniList; MU description).
life_message: Joy can be recovered through the care and company of others.
